title: Vague 'partial search up to 250' has no proof content; remove or make precise

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: The proof of Proposition 1 ends: 'the same procedure was also run, partially, for bases up to 250 without finding any solution.' A *partial* search is not a theorem: the range searched, the tuples covered, and the bound on $z$ are unspecified, so this sentence asserts nothing verifiable. It should be deleted or upgraded to a precise exhaustive claim ('no solution with $\max x_i\le B$', $z\le\lfloor B\cdot5^{1/6}\rfloor$, with the finite verification).

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: Re-review against the current solution.tex (N=220 revision): the vague 'partial search up to 250' sentence has been REMOVED. Proposition 1 now makes only the precise exhaustive claim $\max_i x_i\le 220$, backed by Algorithm 1 with proved soundness/completeness/termination. I independently re-ran the exhaustive ordered search to $N=220$ (two-sided $z$-range from Lemma 1) and confirmed no solutions. Recommend marking resolved.
